svg.title: Mixed Radon–Nikodym derivative
svg.desc: For rho equal to length plus counting measure on nonnegative integers, display [0,1]: the reference has endpoint atoms of mass one and continuous density one. The weight is one-half at zero and between endpoints but zero at one. The target has a half atom at zero plus half uniform mass and no atom at one. Atomic mass and continuous density use separate rows.

g.text: A mixed law needs a reference with atoms and length
